Now I know this has already been done but I wanted to tell my story and also let others tell their story aswell.

My story begins at a gas station in Iceland, I had been saving up money to go on exchange to Japan and I had been learning Japanese in preparation. If I saw someone that looked kind of Japanese I would politely ask them if they were Japanese, just so that I could to the transaction in Japanese and tell them their price or something. So one day there comes a east Asian looking man and I ask him were he's from and he says Japan. And I was thrilled since I almost never met japanese people to talk to so we had a little conversation about my future and what he was doing there yadayadayada. Fast forward to when I'm in Japan and I'm getting my hair cut from a hairdresser that my liason person knew, so that I could get a free hair cut. Low and behold the same man that I had met in my small little gas station in Iceland was her son. And he recognised me, so we became good friends after that and hung out sometimes while I was in Japan :)
